name: PictureFormat
description: Contains properties and methods that apply to pictures and OLE objects.
example:
Set myDocument = ActivePresentation.Slides(1)

With myDocument.Shapes(1).PictureFormat

    .Brightness = 0.3

    .Contrast = 0.7

    .ColorType = msoPictureGrayScale

    .CropBottom = 18

End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the four-character creator code for the application in which the specified object was created. For example, if the object was created in Microsoft PowerPoint, this property returns the hexadecimal number 50575054. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Brightness
properties.description: Returns or sets the brightness of the specified picture or OLE object. Read/write.

properties.name: ColorType
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of color transformation applied to the specified picture or OLE object. Read/write.

properties.name: Contrast
properties.description: Returns or sets the contrast for the specified picture or OLE object.

properties.name: CropBottom
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of points that are cropped off the bottom of the specified picture or OLE object. Read/write.

properties.name: CropLeft
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of points that are cropped off the left side of the specified picture or OLE object. Read/write.

properties.name: CropRight
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of points that are cropped off the right side of the specified picture or OLE object. Read/write.

properties.name: CropTop
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of points that are cropped off the top of the specified picture or OLE object. Read/write.

properties.name: TransparencyColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the transparent color for the specified picture as a red-green-blue (RGB) value. Read/write.

properties.name: TransparentBackground
properties.description: Determines whether parts of the picture that are the color defined as the transparent color appear transparent. Applies to bitmaps only. Read/write.

properties.name: Crop
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of points that are cropped off the specified picture or OLE object. Read-only.

methods.name: IncrementBrightness
methods.description: Changes the brightness of the picture by the specified amount.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how much to change the value of the Brightness property for the picture. A positive value makes the picture brighter; a negative value makes the picture darker.

methods.name: IncrementContrast
methods.description: Changes the contrast of the picture by the specified amount.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how much to change the value of the Contrast property for the picture. A positive value increases the contrast; a negative value decreases the contrast.
